newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to unwind down towards 128.80.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to unwind down towards 128.80.

text.p: June notionnel futures traded on MATIF were set to retreat slightly on Wednesday, creeping back towards 128.80, but the underlying tone remains bullish technical analysts said.

"Things got a bit overdone yesterday so we're pulling back now and provided the 128.80 level, which was yesterday's morning support, stays intact we are not in too much trouble," said Jim Dodgin, senior technical analyst at Technical Data here.
He said Wednesday's action was likely to consist of some unwinding after the highs of the last few days.
By 0847 GMT June notionnel futures were down 0.28 at 129.12.
Dodgin said the market found some interim support at 129.16 but broke through this in early trading.
But Dodgin said the contract still looked in fairly positive shape beyond this correction.
"Overall the tone is still fairly bullish and once we get above today's high of 129.50 we're looking at 130.14," he said.

Richard Adcock, technical research manager at HSBC futures in London, also saw a positive outlook, saying the strong rallies of the last few days had confirmed the penetration of the short term downtrend and opened the way for prices to push higher again after a brief retreat.

"We stress...that with a short-term overbought position in place corrections can be looked for to take prices back to the 128.24 region where buying opportunities will be offered," he said in a note to clients.
Dodgin said on the upside he would look for a break above 129.50,52, an area of early highs on Wednesday and a low in late May. Beyond that he noted resistance at 130.14, the high from May 21.
At 0912 GMT, June Pibor were quoted at 96.51, down 0.01 on the day.
